facts.text: ConnectMicroscope(connect_dll=False) loads the connect_zen_blue_dummy module and runs the class against simulated hardware
snap_image stores the acquired image in self.image and uses the active experiment when experiment is None
live_mode_start starts ZEN live mode and returns the live ZenImage; live_mode_stop stops it
get_stage_pos returns the stage x and y position in micrometers
get_objective_name returns the name of the objective in imaging position and get_objective_position returns its turret position
get_microscope_name returns the fixed string 'get_microscope_name not implemented'
stop() writes only the log line 'Microscope operation aborted' and sends no command
trigger_pump starts the RS232 Braintree pump and sleeps for the requested number of seconds
Braintree.close_connection stops the pump and closes the serial port
